prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1297; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so we can address it.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy that covers your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle telematics or dash camera footage, recorded statements, police and claim reports, repair estimates, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials while the claim is open.

Our client's injuries and losses are ongoing, and we expect your prompt written response.
